patterns.note: The site uses a dark mode aesthetic with full-width sections and content centered within a consistent maximum width container.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, often paired with a smaller, lighter secondary text line for context.
A high-contrast dark background with light text is dominant, accented sparingly with a bright yellow for key words and interactive elements.
Content sections below the hero reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid dark background with a subtle border/shadow as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, remaining sticky at the top.
The 'Frequently Asked Questions' section utilizes an accordion pattern, allowing users to expand and collapse answers.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video that plays automatically, creating an immersive and dynamic first impression. The navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that dynamically changes its background from transparent to a solid dark color with a subtle bottom border once the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements subtly fade or slide upwards into view as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement without being distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (e.g., 'Cursor for Designers') create strong visual impact, several times larger than the clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, giving a soft but not overly rounded character.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical padding between main sections, creating an airy feel, while internal section elements maintain a comfortable, well-distributed rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive dark theme, combined with a dynamic video hero and sophisticated, app-like product screenshots, immediately conveys a high-tech and polished brand image. The subtle use of a bright yellow accent against the dark background provides a unique visual signature, making the design feel both modern and premium.
